items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: And that's the way I learned off of his violin.

ctx.x: And that's the way I learned off of his violin. And as I learned off of his violin, I can't play in the other way, but the way it's strung up right-handed. That's the only way I can play.
You played left-handed, though, in those days, too,
